"""Data fix for migration 002: merge duplicate customers into the lowest id."""
import sqlite3

db = sqlite3.connect('/app/shop/shop.db')
with db:
    groups = db.execute("SELECT lower(trim(email)), min(id) FROM customers GROUP BY lower(trim(email))").fetchall()
    moved = dropped = 0
    for email, keep in groups:
        dups = [i for (i,) in db.execute("SELECT id FROM customers WHERE lower(trim(email)) = ? AND id <> ?", (email, keep))]
        for d in dups:
            moved += db.execute("UPDATE orders SET customer_id = ? WHERE customer_id = ?", (keep, d)).rowcount
            dropped += db.execute("DELETE FROM customers WHERE id = ?", (d,)).rowcount
print(f"moved {moved} orders, deleted {dropped} duplicate customers")
EOF

with open(out, 'w') as fh:

        fh.write(f'{p},{n[p]},{len(users[p])}\n')
PY
EOF

#!/bin/bash
# Daily signup rollup for the growth dashboard.
# Usage: rollup.sh [EVENTS_DIR] [OUT_CSV]
set -euo pipefail
dir=${1:-/data/events}
out=${2:-/app/out/signups_by_plan.csv}
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$out")"
shopt -s nullglob
files=("$dir"/*.jsonl "$dir"/*.jsonl.gz)
{
  echo "plan,signups,unique_users"
  zcat -f "${files[@]}" \
    | jq -r 'select(.type == "signup") | [.event_id, .account.plan, .user.id] | @tsv' \
    | LC_ALL=C sort -u -t$'\t' -k1,1 \
    | awk -F'\t' '{ n[$2]++; if (!seen[$2 FS $3]++) u[$2]++ } END { for (p in n) print p "," n[p] "," u[p] }' \
    | LC_ALL=C sort -t, -k2,2nr -k1,1
} > "$out"
EOF
